events.summary: 2,000 wishlists. Thank you. I'm one person building this warehouse, and every one of those 2,000 is someone who looked at a messy shelf and thought "yeah, I'd tidy that." That's a strange and wonderful thing to be told 2,000 times. events.title: Cart Fix: Full Boxes No Longer Lock the Cart
events.summary: Fixed: the cart could not be pushed with full boxes on itSeveral of you reported that the cart would only slide a little in place, and that the wheels looked like they were sinking into the floor. You were right — and it was a bug, not a weight system. The cart doesn't simulate load at all, so a full cart should always push exactly like an empty one.The cause: an open box and a sealed box are two different models, each with its own collision shape. events.title: Controller Support & Demo Achievements
events.summary: You asked for controller support. It's here. A player wrote to me a while back asking for controller support for accessibility reasons — they can't use a keyboard and mouse for long stretches. I said I was working on it. This is that update. It isn't a partial job. You can play the entire game on a controller, from the main menu to the end of a shift, without touching the keyboard once. What that means Everything is on the pad. events.title: The Cart Update — haul six boxes at once
events.summary: You asked for fewer tripsThe most common note from demo players was the same one: too much walking back and forth. Carrying a few items at a time meant a lot of trips between the box station and the shelves.So the warehouse has a cart now. How it worksIt's there from the start. Nothing to unlock — walk up to the handle and grab it. Load your boxes onto it. Four at a time, and it follows you down the aisle. Let go anywhere.
